summary: Comprehensive testing of dynamic consultation schedule settings feature. All backend API tests passed (13/13). All frontend UI tests passed. The new admin panel consultation schedule section works correctly with day toggles, time dropdowns, and live preview text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic consultation schedule feature fully tested. Admin panel 'Homepage numbers' tab has 'Consultation Schedule' section with day toggles (data-testid='slot-day-0' through 'slot-day-6'), start/end time dropdowns (data-testid='slot-start-hour', 'slot-end-hour'), and preview text (data-testid='slot-preview-text'). Backend APIs: GET /api/consultation-config returns config with days, startHour, endHour, displayText. GET /api/consultation-slots?date=YYYY-MM-DD&duration=30|60 returns available slots based on saved config. Weekend dates are rejected with 400 if not in allowed days. Frontend consultation section shows dynamic availability text matching admin settings. Date picker in booking modal shows only dates matching admin-configured days.

admin_consultation_schedule_section.details: Consultation Schedule section visible in Homepage numbers tab with day toggles, time dropdowns, and preview text

admin_day_toggle_buttons.details: Day toggle buttons (Mon-Sun) work correctly. Toggling Friday adds/removes it from preview text immediately

admin_start_time_dropdown.details: Start time dropdown (data-testid='slot-start-hour') updates preview text immediately when changed

admin_end_time_dropdown.details: End time dropdown (data-testid='slot-end-hour') updates preview text immediately when changed

admin_preview_text.details: Preview text (data-testid='slot-preview-text') shows 'Slots are available only on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday from 2 PM to 5 PM.' and updates dynamically

admin_save_settings.details: Save settings button persists consultation schedule to database (verified via API)

api_consultation_config.details: GET /api/consultation-config returns days, dayNames, startHour, endHour, slotMinutes, displayText

api_consultation_slots_valid_date.details: GET /api/consultation-slots with valid Mon-Thu date returns slots for 30-min and 60-min durations

api_consultation_slots_weekend_rejected.details: GET /api/consultation-slots with weekend date returns 400 error when weekends not in allowed days

frontend_consultation_availability_text.details: Consultation section shows dynamic availability text: 'Slots are available only on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday from 2 PM to 5 PM.'

frontend_booking_modal_date_picker.details: Booking modal date picker shows only Mon-Thu dates (Monday 19 Oct, Tuesday 20 Oct, Wednesday 21 Oct, Thursday 22 Oct)

consultation_page_share_copy_buttons.details: /#/consultation page has Share and Copy link buttons with correct data-testids

favicon_cache_busting.details: 4 favicon links found with ?v=2 cache-busting parameter

manifest_json.details: manifest.json loads correctly with 'Rehabilified' name and icons array
